_doc: WHICH WORKERS MAY ANSWER THE PUBLIC INTERNET. Declared here and verified against the live workers.dev surface by .github/scripts/verify-public-surface.mjs, because wrangler.jsonc is a report and the question is reachability. Found necessary on 19 Aug 2026: marginsheet-sync was publicly reachable in all three environments while a test named 'unreachable from the public internet' passed, because it asserted not.toBe(true) against an ABSENT workers_dev and absent means PUBLISHED.

workers.name: marginsheet-api
workers.why: The household-facing API. This is the front door and it is meant to answer.

workers.name: marginsheet-conversation
workers.why: Reached over a service binding. Nothing about it is a household entry point.

workers.name: marginsheet-sync
workers.why: M4 section 2a: it holds TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY, which decrypts every household's Plaid token. The ENTIRE argument for a third deployable is that a household request cannot arrive here. A reachable sync Worker is not a smaller version of the boundary, it is the absence of it.

probe.note: REACHABLE MEANS OUR WORKER ANSWERED, not that the hostname resolved. A disabled workers.dev subdomain still returns a Cloudflare page, so status alone cannot tell them apart and the body is checked for a marker only our Worker emits.
